skill.name: amazon-reviews-api-skill
skill.description: Extract Amazon product review data through the BrowserAct Amazon Reviews API using a product ASIN and a BrowserAct API key.
skill.summary: Fetches Amazon review workflow data for one ASIN through BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most markdown backtick and system-reconnaissance alerts are false positives from documentation text. Confirmed risks remain from BrowserAct network calls, sensitive API key handling, local script execution, unsafe key collection guidance, and anti-bot evasion positioning.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide API keys in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through a secure environment variable or secret store.
Remove claims about avoiding captcha and IP restrictions. Add guidance to follow Amazon terms, robots policies, and privacy rules.

remediation.issue: External command execution with user input
remediation.suggestion: Validate ASIN values against the expected Amazon ASIN format before invoking the script. Document that agents must not run arbitrary commands.
Document that the BrowserAct API key is sent only to BrowserAct. Never log the key, and mask credential values in all errors.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe API Key Collection Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to ask the user to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY, and the script says users can provide the key to the agent. This encourages secret disclosure in chat instead of secure environment configuration.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both cited lines explicitly direct the user toward providing an API key to the agent. The evidence is direct and not inferred from variable names alone.

semantic_findings.title: Anti-Bot Restriction Evasion Positioning

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited feature claims directly mention captcha and IP restrictions. Legitimate use is possible, but the wording strongly indicates bypass-oriented positioning.

content.value_statement: Teams need structured Amazon review data for product and market analysis. This skill uses BrowserAct to run an ASIN-based review workflow.
actual_capabilities: Reads a BrowserAct API key from BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Submits one Amazon ASIN to a BrowserAct workflow template.
Polls BrowserAct task status with timestamped progress messages.
Reports invalid authorization errors for expired or wrong API keys.
Documents review fields such as rating, title, text, country, variant, and verified purchase status.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and outbound network access.
Accepts one ASIN per script run.
Results depend on BrowserAct availability and Amazon page access.
The current script may need a control-flow fix before it returns final review data.

use_cases.title: Analyze Competitor Reviews
use_cases.description: Collect review themes for a competitor ASIN and compare customer praise, complaints, and rating patterns.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sentiment Research
use_cases.description: Gather review text and ratings for a product before running sentiment or topic analysis.

use_cases.title: Track Quality Signals
use_cases.description: Review verified purchase feedback to identify defects, missing features, and support issues.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch One Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to fetch reviews for ASIN B07TS6R1SF. Summarize ratings, common themes, and verified purchase signals.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Complaints
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused feedback analysis for one product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for ASIN B08N5WRWJ6. List the most common complaints and quote short representative review themes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Run this skill for two ASINs I provide. Compare praised features, recurring issues, rating trends, and verified purchase patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Build Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for my target ASIN list. Create a research brief with sentiment themes, quality risks, and product improvement ideas.

output_examples.input: Fetch reviews for one ASIN and summarize customer sentiment.
output_examples.output: A short review summary with average rating context, common positive themes, frequent complaints, and notable verified purchase patterns.

output_examples.input: Compare reviews for two competing products.
output_examples.output: A comparison table in prose form covering strengths, weaknesses, recurring defects, and differences in customer expectations.

output_examples.input: Find quality issues from recent product reviews.
output_examples.output: A prioritized list of reported issues, affected variants, example review themes, and suggested follow-up checks for the product team.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in a secure environment variable before using the skill.
Use valid ASIN values and review results for authorized research purposes.
Check platform terms and privacy rules before collecting or storing review data.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not use the skill to bypass access controls or platform restrictions.
Do not treat extracted reviews as complete market truth without sampling checks.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs one Amazon ASIN and a BrowserAct API key configured as BROWSERACT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Does it require an Amazon login?
faq.answer: The documentation says it uses BrowserAct workflow automation instead of an Amazon account login.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: The skill documents reviewer name, profile link, rating, title, review text, date, country, variant, and verification status.

faq.question: Can it analyze sentiment by itself?
faq.answer: It collects review data. Sentiment summaries or models must be performed by the agent after extraction.

faq.question: Is the API key handled safely?
faq.answer: The current instructions need improvement. Users should set the key in a secure environment variable, not paste it into chat.

faq.question: Can it process many ASINs at once?
faq.answer: The included script accepts one ASIN per run. Batch workflows require repeated runs or additional orchestration.
